annotations.title: Save a draft as my website

description: Use this when the person likes a draft from crear_borrador_web and wants to keep it as their own website. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Creates a new free website in their account from the draft (it never overwrites an existing website) and returns its address, e.g. https://name.palimpalem.com/. The login details are e-mailed to the person. Calling it again with the same draft returns the same website.

draft.description: The draft link (https://palimpalem.com/palim/apli/entwurf.php?t=...) or its 24-character token.

subdomain.description: Optional. Wished address name, e.g. panaderia-ruzafa for panaderia-ruzafa.palimpalem.com. Letters a-z, digits and hyphens, 3 to 25. Without it a name is suggested from the business name.
